title: What If the Earth Stopped Spinning? Here's What Would Happen
short_title: What if Earth stopped spinning right now? 🌍 #shorts
description:
Right now, you are moving at up to 1,000 miles per hour. So what would happen if the Earth suddenly stopped spinning? Hurricane-force winds, oceans rushing to the poles, a day that lasts a whole year… Here is what science says, step by step.

{CHAPITRES}

Subscribe to Factora so you never miss a fascinating fact.

Sources: NASA (Earth's rotation, ~1,670 km/h at the equator; what if Earth stopped spinning); NOAA / National Weather Service (hurricane winds); Witold Fraczek, Esri (2010), simulation of oceans on a non-rotating Earth; USGS & NASA (geodynamo and Earth's magnetic field); Stephenson et al. (2016), Proceedings of the Royal Society A, lengthening of the day (~1.8 ms per century).

Synthetic voice, original illustrations.
